result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at then-current rates, data return/export within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion with written certification. It is narrowly added as a new surviving section and does not disturb the existing survival, customer-use, or support provisions. Drafting is professional, though the data-return deadline runs from Corio’s request rather than directly from termination, and “thereafter” leaves the precise deletion deadline unspecified.
